title: A Canary in the Neural Mine: Catching an Image Classifier's Silent, Confident Failures
abstract: arXiv:2610.33063v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deployed vision models auto-accept confident predictions, so high-confidence errors propagate silently. Maximum Softmax Probability (MSP), the standard failure predictor, has a structural blind spot: as a scalar read from the classifier head, it is first-order blind to feature variation orthogonal to its confidence gradient. Through a factorial analysis of feature-space detectors, we identify a conditional-redundancy principle explaining why they fail to complement MSP: the class-separability geometry they measure is already encoded in MSP and collapses under fusion. translated_title: 神经网络矿井中的金丝雀：捕捉图像分类器的静默而自信的失败
translated_abstract: 部署的视觉模型会自动接受高置信度的预测，因此高置信度的错误会静默传播。作为标准失败预测器的最大Softmax概率（MSP）存在结构性盲点：作为从分类器头部读取的标量，它对与其置信度梯度正交的特征变化是一阶盲的。通过对特征空间检测器的因子分析，我们确定了一个条件冗余原则，解释了为什么它们无法与MSP形成互补：它们所测量的类可分性几何已经被编码在MSP中，并在融合时坍缩。能够幸存下来的信号是流形外残差上的类条件典型性——由于该残差的分布随骨干网络而变化，从近高斯到重尾分布不等，因此必须进行非参数估计。我们将这些发现实例化为CANARY，一个免训练的检测器，它在倒数第二层特征的PCA残差上计算每类的kNN距离……
tldr: 提出免训练检测器CANARY，通过在倒数第二层特征的PCA残差上计算每类kNN距离，捕捉图像分类器中MSP因结构性盲点而无法发现的静默高置信度失败。
en_tdlr: CANARY, a training-free detector that computes per-class kNN distances on the PCA residual of penultimate features, catches image classifiers' silent, confident failures that fall within MSP's structural blind spot.
